title: Migrate and Sync Word States
description: Ensure all existing word progress data is properly synced by Persian text, and fix any duplicate/inconsistent entries.

acceptanceCriteria.text: CONTEXT7 FIRST: Research Convex batch mutations for data migration
Create migration script `convex/wordProgress.ts:deduplicateWordProgress` that groups by `(visitorId, persian)` field
Run migration via `npx convex run wordProgress:deduplicateWordProgress`
Verify no duplicate entries exist for same `(visitorId, persian)` pair
Fixed `incrementViewCount` and `incrementPlayCount` to use persian as key (prevents new duplicates)
Test: After migration, word states are consistent (verified "برای" syncs between Line 1 and Line 2)
